general_information.Description: -Course objectives: The subject is aimed at providing a vital and comprehensive understanding of destination marketing and management -Description: Managing destinations is an area of growing importance as tourism regions compete to provide unique experiences and exceptional value to visitors. Principles and concepts of building strong destinations are explored to assist future tourism professionals in establishing stronger regional & international tourism organizations while responding to the needs and wants of community residents. -Teaching method: Basic input will be given by the lecturer in order to initiate discussions on the relevant topics. Therefore, students are required to prepare the reading material in advance. In class, short group works will take place. This should further stimulate discussion between students and allow them to immediately apply theoretical knowledge to mini-case studies. Additionally, discussion should allow students to reflect on observations of tourist destinations and identify linkages with management and marketing activities.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments, and labs given by the instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purposes - Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To examine and differentiate the key concepts and roles of marketing and management of destinations
To identify the stakeholders in destination management, the types of destination management organisations and the relationships they are in
To assess the nature and process of planning and research for destination management and marketing
To appreciate the key concerns in developing destination product
To highlight and develop the leadership, partnership and governance in destination management
To clarify the need for and the procedure of visitor management
To discuss the concept and the steps to build destination positioning, image, branding and intergrated marketing communications
To be able to build a comprehensive plan for marketing and management of a destination
To appreciate and develop a professional and critical attitude towards the job of destination marketing and management

schedule.Topic: Topic 1 (cont'd) 1. Explain the characteristics of a tourism destination. 2. Define destination management and destination marketing. 3. Identify and explain the roles of destination management. 4. Differentiate between destination management and destination marketing.

Topic 1 (cont'd) 5. Categorize the stakeholders in destination management into groups. 6. Explain the 10 As of successful destinations. 7. Provide a definition of destination governance and identify the strengths of the public and private sectors. 8. Describe the types of destination management organizations at different geographic levels.

Topic 2: Destination planning 1. Describe the history and influences on tourism planning for destinations. 2. Explain the benefits that come from doing long-term tourism planning. 3. Detail the desired outcomes from completing a tourism plan for a destination.
Topic 2 (cont'd) 4. Identify the contents of a tourism plan for a destination. 5. Elaborate on the different geographic levels for destination tourism planning.
Topic 2 (cont'd) 6. Explain the tourism planning process for destination management. 7. Differentiate between strategic planning and visioning.
Topic 2 (cont'd) 8. Provide a step-by-step explanation of destination visioning. 9. Pinpoint the advantages of using tourism planning toolkits.

Topic 3: Destination marketing planning 1. Explain the key destination marketing professional principles. 2. Describe the different levels of goals and objectives in the destination marketing planning process. 3. Differentiate between a vision and a mission.
Topic 3 (cont'd) 4. Identify the meaning of the components of the PRICE model.
Topic 3 (cont'd) 5. Provide a detailed explanation of the steps in the destination marketing system (DMS). 6. Describe the contents of a destination marketing plan.

Topic 3 (cont'd) 7. Give an explanation of each of the 8 Ps of destination marketing. 8. Explain how key result areas (KRAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) are used to measure the marketing performance of destination management organizations (DMOs).

Topic 4: Destination management research 1. Explain the contributions of research to destination management. 2. Describe the components of a destination management research agenda. 3. Discuss the steps in the destination management research process.

Topic 4 (cont'd) 4. Define and differentiate between primary and secondary research. 5. Detail the procedures for analyzing existing markets in visitor profile studies. 6. Explain how a destination conducts a potential market analysis. 7. Describe the techniques for doing destination image research.

Topic 4 (cont'd) 8. Elaborate on the importance of gathering resident attitudes and opinions about tourism. 9. Pinpoint the types of research projects that are done in a destination audit. 10. Describe the research approaches for measuring economic impact.

Topic 4 (cont'd) 11. Delineate procedures for completing competitive research. 12. Explain performance measurement in destination management. 13. Outline the elements of a destination management research plan. 14. Identify criteria for selecting research vendors.
Individual assignment: Individual presentations 1
Individual assignment: Individual presentations 1 (cont'd)
Topic 1 - 4 Review and Test 1
Group assignment guide 1

Topic 5: Destination product development 1. Define the destination product and identify its components. 2. Discuss principles of destination product development including sustainable tourism. 3. Explain the Tourism Area Life Cycle Model and how this impacts the destination product. 4. Describe the continuum of DMO involvement in product development. 5. Differentiate between hard and soft product development.

Topic 5 (cont'd) 6. Explain the importance and dimensions of destination quality. 7. Elaborate on product development strategy models and how they are applied to destination product development. 8. Identify the physical products in a destination and explain how potential development projects are analyzed. 9. Describe the roles of visitor information centres (VICs).

Topic 5 (cont'd) 10. Define accessible tourism and explain its importance in destination development. 11. Identify different types of tourism signage. 12. Elaborate on the types of strategies and programmes that a DMO can offer to enhance human resource development. 13. Explain the roles and benefits of packaging and what the DMO can do to encourage greater packaging.

Topic 5 (cont'd) 14. Pinpoint the different forms of programming in which a destination can engage and how a DMO can encourage event, festival, and activity programmes. 15. Define experience design and identify the characteristics of effectively crafted visitor experiences. 16. Explain the roles of interpretation for a destination.

Topic 6: Destination leadership, governance and partnership 1. Define the terms destination partnership and team building. 2. Discuss how partnerships contribute to the accomplishment of the other roles of destination management. 3. Describe the relationship between destination governance and destination partnerships.
Topic 6 (cont'd) 4. Explain the benefits of destination partnerships. 5. Discuss the potential partners for DMOs. 6. Elaborate on how a DMO identifies potential partners.

Topic 6 (cont'd) 7. Explain the concept of public–private partnerships (PPPs) and their advantages. 8. Pinpoint and explain the barriers and challenges in forming destination partnerships. 9. Identify the types of partnerships into which DMOs can enter.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Review Chapter 6 and 8 Presentation and discussion

schedule.Topic: Topic 6 (cont'd) 10. Describe the ingredients of a successful destination partnership. 11. Explain how a DMO performs as a destination team builder.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Review Chapter 6 and 8 Presentation and discussion

schedule.Topic: Topic 7: Destination community and stakeholder relationships and involvement 1. Explain the importance of community relationships and involvement to destination management. 2. Describe the reasons and benefits of having positive relationships with local community residents. 3. Discuss the activities included in managing the relationships and involvement of local community residents.

Topic 7 (cont'd) 4. Define the term stakeholders. 5. Pinpoint varying strategies for relationship management with different groups of stakeholders. 6. Identify and describe the tourism sector stakeholders in a destination.

Topic 7 (cont'd) 7. Elaborate upon the activities that a DMO should use to maintain positive relationships with and involvement of tourism sector stakeholders. 8. Discuss the reasons for having DMO membership programmes.

Topic 7 (cont'd) 9. Describe the activities in DMO relationships with and involvement of members. 10. Review the benefits that DMOs provide to members. 11. Explain the important considerations with DMO boards of directors.

Topic 8: Visitor management 1. Define destination leadership and destination coordination. 2. Explain the key leadership functions of DMOs. 3. Briefly describe different leadership theories and approaches. 4. Review servant leadership and explain why it is appropriate for destination management. 5. Define corporate social responsibility (CSR) and how it is applied in destination management.

Topic 8 (cont'd) 6. Elaborate on ethical codes and practices for DMOs and their leaders. 7. Discuss the ‘silo effect’ and its presence in the tourism sector and destinations. 8. Explain destination coordination and how DMOs accomplish coordination. 9. Review the links from destination leadership and coordination to governance. 10. Define the term destination governance and identify the dimensions of governance.

Topic 8 (cont'd) 11. Describe accountability and the actions required of a DMO to demonstrate it is accountable. 12. Explain the concept of transparency and how this applies to a DMO. 13. Identify the ways in which DMOs can measure performance.

Topic 8 (cont'd) 14. Explain how DMO organizational structures are related to destination governance. 15. Discuss the different funding mechanisms and sources available for DMOs. 16. Define bylaws and how they affect destination governance. 17. Review how the chairpersons of boards of directors can be influential in DMO governance. 18. Identify and review the types of risk to which DMOs and destinations are exposed and how they should handle risk management.
Individual assignment: Individual presentations 2
Individual assignment: Individual presentations 2 (cont'd)
Topic 5 - 8 Review and Test 2
Group assignment guide 2
Topic 9: Destination branding 1. Define visitor management. 2. Explain the ADVICE model for visitor management.

Topic 9 (cont'd) 3. Describe the reasons for and benefits from visitor management. 4. Review resource protection and conservation from the visitor management perspective. 5. Detail the procedures in visitor planning, monitoring and management.

Topic 9 (cont'd) 6. Elaborate on the importance and steps required to assure visitor safety and security within destinations. 7. Detail the procedures for crisis and disaster management for destinations. 8. Explain the provision of visitor interpretation, education and information. 9. Review visitor expectations, experiences, enjoyment and satisfaction.

Topic 9 (cont'd) 10. Describe the need to monitor and manage visitor behaviour. 11. Explain the application of yield management to destinations. 12. Identify other reasons for visitor management efforts.

Topic 10: Destination integrated marketing communications 1. Explain the positioning–image–branding approach and define these three interconnected concepts. 2. Discuss the relationships among destination positioning, image and branding.
Topic 10 (cont'd) 3. Identify and describe the importance and benefits of destination branding. 4. Elaborate upon the major challenges in implementing destination branding.
Topic 10 (cont'd) 5. Pinpoint why destination brands sometimes fail. 6. Review the characteristics of a good destination brand. 7. Explain the classic concepts of branding.
Topic 10 (cont'd) 8. Outline and describe the steps to be followed in destination branding. 9. Describe the brand promise concept.

Topic 11: Destination markets 1. Describe the elements of the basic model of communications. 2. Define integrated marketing communications and explain the benefits that DMOs derive by following this approach. 3. Identify and elaborate upon each of the major components of integrated marketing communications.

Topic 11 (cont'd) 4. Explain the importance and roles of advertising in promoting a destination. 5. Describe how personal selling is essential for DMOs in securing business from specific market segments and identify the roles of personal selling in destination marketing.

Topic 11 (cont'd) 6. Review why public relations and publicity are required for a DMO to build and maintain relationships with its multiple publics. 7. Identify a DMOs’ internal and external publics. 8. Point out the roles played by sales promotion and merchandising for DMOs. 9. Describe the different sales promotion and merchandising techniques.

Topic 11 (cont'd) 10. Identify the main digital marketing techniques and venues. 11. Explain the concept of crowdsourcing and the different ways that this concept can be applied in destination integrated marketing communications. 12. Elaborate on the relationship between movies and films and destination marketing and development. 13. Review the concept of theme and event years as a basis for DMO integrated marketing communications. 14. Discuss the steps involved in the planning, implementation and evaluation of an integrated marketing communications (IMC) campaign.
